key_events: I am the latest in a long line of Herbalists who have tended to this village and the surrounding woods.
My knowledge was not learned from books, but passed down from my grandmother, who learned it from the whispers of the woods.
I remember the birth of the twins, Elian and Lian. It was under a Blue Moon, a time of great and dangerous magical confluence.
I warned their parents that such a birth would create a profound imbalance, but they did not understand.
I am one of the few who knows the true legend of the Mindbloom Petal, and I am its self-appointed guardian. It is a cure, but a dangerous one.
